name: ToastProvider
purpose: React context and viewport provider that owns visible toast state, auto-dismiss timers, and pause/resume behavior.

guidance.useWhen: Use around a React subtree that needs the useToast controller and VyrnForge toast viewport.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid as a replacement for persistent alerts, required validation, destructive confirmation, or notification history.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Wrap any React subtree that calls useToast; keep toast feedback transient and application business state outside the provider.

accessibility: The viewport label is configurable; pause-on-focus and pause-on-hover default to true, while individual Toast records own their live-region roles.
knownLimitations: Avoid required validation, persistent alerts, destructive confirmation, and notification history.
